_neck_spine_term: E12 Ruling 20c, on the Director's eye at the v7 set: 'The horns on his upper-spine (back of his neck) also don't look right.' CONFIRMED against the canon's own letter - D6 read 'from shoulders to tail tip' and D5's ring covers 'skull and jaw', so the NAPE CREST between them was UNNAMED: the THIRD unclaimed surface his eye has found (wing arms, then finger struts, now this), painted as crown-ivory vertebrae exactly as the founding law predicts. D6's letter now reads 'the ridge from the nape to the tail tip' and carries TWO prompt terms for one element (the D1 multi-term precedent). Terms are comma-free by the deletion-construction grammar: Ruling 20c's prose form 'charcoal dorsal, neck and tail spines' carries an internal comma that would SHATTER the term at this builder, which is why the fixture and the profile both land on two comma-free phrases and the profile entry is what this file derives from.
_occupancy_audit: E12 Ruling 20c. Rather than find a fourth unclaimed surface at the Director's eye, every modelled structure was enumerated against every element's letter across the front, profile, rear-crown and head clays. Closed in one fold: nape crest -> D6 (this term); shoulder and hip spurs -> D6's surface list with a watch note (they earn their own term only if the v8 set mislands them); brow horns and jaw barbels -> D5's list, explicit. The legs are re-confirmed smooth - any bone lines there are paint. The audit table lives in canon/DRAGON-IDENTITY.md and every future element edit re-checks it rather than discovering its gap at generation.
_split_provenance: E12 Ruling 9d default with the MEASURED deviation ruled at E12 Ruling 10i: views 3 and 5 hide the whole head behind the near wing membrane (head-box first-hit 0.81% of figure, and that is WING passing through the box's region of space, against 5.35-12.79% on the head-bearing views). A near wing that hides a HEAD does not hide a crest that stands above it.
_wing_terms: E12 Rulings 17e and 18c, carried forward unchanged. The wing arms and finger struts are D1's surface and each stands as its own noun phrase. HISTORICAL, and the reason the exemplar rebuild exists rather than a patch: at 770700 the struts resisted across THREE stems on view 4 (unnamed / compound / split) and bound completely at 770701 - so term binding is SEED-DEPENDENT (Ruling 20a), the per-view bounded re-roll is the lever, and no seed sweep exists.
